about.hero_subtitle: ReaxOne was born from physical preparation applied to the real game.
about.philosophy_p1: Every product is designed to develop reaction, decision-making and direct transfer to competition — not just mechanical repetition.
about.philosophy_p2: We work with athletes, coaches and clubs that demand method, precision and purpose in every stimulus.
about.reaction_title:
Those who react first,
decide better.
about.reaction_p_after: . Reaction determines performance before the action takes place.
about.neural_speed_desc: Trains the nervous system to respond faster.
about.stimulus_reading_desc: You don't react to what you expect — you react to what happens.
about.first_step_desc: The right step at the right moment makes all the difference.
about.modalities_subtitle: The reaction ball adapts to any sport that demands speed, reading and decision.
about.m01_desc: Reaction, positioning and split-step efficiency in unpredictable rallies.
about.m02_desc: Read the bounce. React before the opponent's shot.
about.m03_desc: First step, perception and decision-making under pressure.
about.m04_desc: Build neural foundations for strong habits from an early age.
about.m05_desc: Develop coordination, attention and reflexes from the earliest ages in a fun way.
about.m06_desc: Cognitive and physical stimulation for dogs — focus training, agility and reaction instinct.
about.training_title:
How to train with the
reaction ball
about.training_subtitle: Four ways to integrate ReaxOne into your training and get the most out of your response speed.
about.t01_desc: Drop the ball from different heights and react to the first bounce. Start slow and progressively increase speed.
about.t02_desc: A partner throws the ball without warning. Focus on reading and the first step. Maximum difficulty.
about.t03_desc: Add a visual or verbal stimulus before the drop. Train information processing under competitive stress.
about.t04_desc: Integrate into technical warm-up — padel, tennis, football. Direct link between training stimulus and real movement.
about.products_title:
The reaction ball that
changes training
about.products_p: Unique irregular geometry that makes every bounce completely unpredictable. Used by athletes and high-performance coaches in padel, football, tennis and sports development.

bola-reacao-verde.name: Green Reaction Ball
bola-reacao-verde.description: The ReaxOne Reaction Ball was developed to train reflexes, coordination and response speed. The irregular design guarantees unpredictable bounces for a more effective workout.

bola-reacao-verde-padel.name: Green Reaction Ball — Padel
bola-reacao-verde-padel.description: Developed specifically for padel training. Train your reaction time and improve hand-eye coordination on and off the court.

bola-reacao-branca.name: White Reaction Ball
bola-reacao-branca.description: The white version of our premium reaction ball. Ideal for indoor and outdoor training, with the same performance and durability as the green line.

bola-reacao-branca-pack.name: White Reaction Ball — Double Pack
bola-reacao-branca-pack.description: Pack with two white reaction balls. Ideal for training with a partner or always having one in reserve. Save 15% compared to individual purchase.

padel-sem-lesoes.name: Padel Without Injuries
padel-sem-lesoes.description: Your body is your best equipment. Train at home, play without fear. 8 weeks of physical training created by a Personal Trainer and Padel Coach to strengthen your body, prevent the most common padel injuries and improve your endurance — no gym, no equipment needed. Includes reaction training with ReaxOne® and scientific references in each chapter.

exercicios-para-beginners.name: Exercises for Beginners
exercicios-para-beginners.description: Your first step towards a more active life. Free guide with basic exercises for those just starting out — no equipment, no prior experience required. Includes reaction and coordination tips with ReaxOne®.
